title: The assurance package's standalone verifier refuses what it says it refuses, at the level it says
note: The directive's Part X, item 34, and Part XI, items 35 and 36. Each mutation removes one rule of tools/verify_assurance.py: a file check, a consistency check between the record and its evidence, a rule of the event chain, a check of a decision against the history, a step of the verifier's own closed-form recheck, or a rule of how a run ends. tests/test_assurance_package.py holds each with a copy of the committed package that has exactly one thing wrong, refused at the level and the check that should catch it and at no earlier one.

mutations.replace: check("every listed file is present", True, f"missing {missing}")
mutations.rationale: a file the manifest lists may be absent, and what it held is simply not read
